description: Odfjell Drilling Ltd. owns and operates mobile offshore drilling units primarily in Norway and Namibia. The company operates through two segments, Own Fleet and External Fleet. It also offers management services to other owners of drilling units, such as operational management, regulatory requirements management, marketing, contract negotiations and client relations, and operation and mobilization preparation services. The company was founded in 1914 and is based in Aberdeen, the United Kingdom.
